Name: Ptty PC Monitor
Author: hollobar

Actions.Name: Sensor
Actions.Tooltip: Shows CPU/GPU temperature and load, RAM, internet speed or fan RPM.

Actions.Name: Monitor Brightness
Actions.Tooltip: Adjusts monitor brightness and contrast with a Stream Deck + dial (DDC/CI).

Description: Shows CPU/GPU temperature and load, RAM usage, internet speed and fan RPM on keys, and adjusts monitor brightness and contrast with Stream Deck + dials. Reading sensors requires the Ptty PC Monitor sensor service to be installed as well.
